recommendation: Keep this audit commit as-is. Revisit only if FHIR-I separately decides that the primitive markdown datatype definition/comment should also carry renderer-safety warning text or if future renderer guidance changes the approved escaping advice.
issue_request: FHIR-40387 was Published/Persuasive for R5 after a FHIR-I vote and asked to add a warning bullet to the base "About the markdown datatype" guidance telling systems that transmit plain string data in markdown fields to escape markdown formatting characters to avoid information loss when rendered.
initial_application: FHIR-40387 was explicitly applied by 14d0d18cf8420b9b33cb9e0d5647b0a48caa53fe, which added the warning bullet and an implementation note to source/datatypes.html, and by 67661b5631a3d13852974a79a71156a148f6389a, which corrected the implementation note text and closing marker.
additional_context: source/datatypes.html is part of the active datatype source area and currently includes the requested warning plus an escaping implementation note. source/datatypes/primitives.xml still has only the general primitive markdown comment, but the Jira resolution targeted the narrative About section rather than the primitive table cell. The FHIR-39574 GenomicStudy markdown discussion explains the genomics star-allele concern that led to FHIR-40387 and is already represented by a separate combined-branch reconciliation commit.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current core source already implements the approved guidance in the requested location. Duplicating the warning into the primitive definition/comment would go beyond the approved scope and create a redundant maintenance surface.

related_jiras.note: The GenomicStudy.description markdown discussion raised the plain-string escaping concern and led Kevin Power to file FHIR-40387; FHIR-39574 already has its own reconciliation commit on the combined branch.
